claims: Passover (Pesach) is a 7-8 day Jewish holiday.
Passover begins on 15 Nisan.
Passover in 2026 is April 1-9.
Passover commemorates the biblical Exodus.
Israelites were freed from Egyptian slavery in the biblical Exodus.
Passover traditions include holding a Seder.
Passover traditions include eating matzah.
Passover traditions include removing all leavened bread (chametz) from homes.
The Exodus occurred around 3,400 years ago.
Moses demanded the release of the Israelites from Pharaoh.
Pharaoh refused to release the Israelites.
Egypt was struck by ten plagues.
The final plague involved the death of the firstborn male.
Israelites marked their doorposts with lamb's blood.
God passed over the homes of the Israelites sparing them.
Pharaoh allowed the Israelites to leave after the final plague.
Israelites left Egypt in such a hurry that their bread did not have time to rise.
The hurried departure leads to the tradition of eating unleavened bread (matzah).
The Passover Seder is a 15-step ritual-rich feast.
The Seder is the central experience of Passover.
The primary purpose of the Seder is to pass the history of the Exodus down to new generations.
The Haggadah facilitates passing the history of the Exodus at the Seder.
Seder participants eat maror (bitter herbs for the bitterness of slavery).
Seder participants eat matzah (unleavened bread).
Four cups of wine are consumed at the Seder to represent the promises of redemption.
Homes are thoroughly cleaned before Passover to remove all chametz (leavened grain products).
Jews avoid eating bread, pasta, and cookies during Passover.
Jews often sell their remaining chametz to non-Jews during Passover.
Passover is celebrated for seven days in Israel.
Many Diaspora communities celebrate Passover for eight days.
Core biblical requirements of Passover include eating matzah.
Core biblical requirements of Passover include telling the story.
Core biblical requirements of Passover are universal.
Ashkenazi Jews traditionally avoided kitniyot during Passover.
Some Ashkenazi Jews have recently begun to incorporate kitniyot.
Passover 2026 is from sunset April 1 to nightfall April 9.
Passover 2027 is from sunset April 21 to nightfall April 29.
Passover 2028 is from sunset April 10 to nightfall April 18.
Passover 2029 is from sunset March 30 to nightfall April 7.
Passover 2030 is from sunset April 17 to nightfall April 25.
